output.sql: SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.net_revenue))::numeric, 2) AS median_net_order_value FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This returns the median net revenue per order, in EUR, for completed orders (is_revenue is true) placed in 2025. Shipping fees are excluded. PERCENTILE_CONT interpolates between the two middle values when the number of orders is even.
